subject: Unable to deploy package dependency 'Rstem'    The package was installed locally from source

messages.author: 84615f3df804a4ba
messages.subject: Unable to deploy package dependency 'Rstem'    The package was installed locally from source
parts:
Hi

I wanted to Deploy an App on shiny apps.io

I created an app that works fine on my local machine but deploying it is a challenge as some packages like Rstem were removed from CRAN and I manually installed those packages on my local R instance. 

Whilst deploying on shiny apps the following error is displayed:

Unable to deploy package dependency 'Rstem'    The package was installed locally from source

Is there a work around?


thanks
Abhishek

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Unable to deploy package dependency 'Rstem' The package was installed locally from source
parts:
Hi,

Currently ShinyApps only supports installing packages from CRAN or PUBLIC GitHub repositories. 

However since this package was formally on CRAN you could try to install it by doing:

devtools::install_version('Rstem', '0.4-1')

Then running: 

deployApp()

I am not 100% sure this will work, please let me know if it does.

-Andy
